title: 2023 Panini Prizm #47 D.J. Moore Chicago Bears Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Prizm trading card featuring DJ Moore of the Chicago Bears in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a base set card, not autographed, and part of the Prizm parallel/variety. It is card number 47 in the set and manufactured by Panini in the United States.
